$comment: Where releases live. Read by the app (Help links, Settings > Updates), the desktop updater (src-tauri/src/updates.rs) and docs/releasing.md. While either value is empty, the GitHub links stay hidden and the desktop app doesn't check for updates. githubRepo is 'owner/name' of a PUBLIC repo; updaterPubkey is the one-line contents of the .pub file from `npx tauri signer generate` (never the private key).
